Hill Says FDIC Won’t Rule Out Agentic AI Bank-Run Risk
videos.description: Travis Hill, FDIC chairman, says the agency is not ruling out risks from AI tools that could allow customers to move deposits more quickly in search of higher returns, though he says such a scenario would require a significant shift in how customers delegate financial decisions. Hill also says there is a “strong case” for expanding deposit insurance coverage, either by raising the current limit or creating a category of accounts with higher coverage. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: Microsoft’s Trillion-Dollar Quarter Shows AI Trade Won’t Quit
videos.description: Microsoft Corp.'s shares jumped 37.5% from July through September, their best quarterly showing since 1998, adding $1 trillion to the company's market capitalization. The company's earnings in late July showed the fastest cloud growth in four years from strong AI demand, easing concerns about whether Microsoft's heavy AI investments would lead to better growth. There are 72 analysts tracked by Bloomberg who follow the company, and only three don't have buy ratings, with the average price target suggesting the shares will rise about 11% in the coming 12 months. Bloomberg's Ryan Vlastelica joins to discuss. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
